tracks.name: All-camp Activities
tracks.banner: Some programs require advance sign-up and may have limited spots including Archery and Sonora Taqueria! These programs are noted on the schedule, so sign-up early and don't miss out!

events.title: Welcome Campers!
events.description: **Welcome Campers!** Come check-in and get your welcome packet at the Volleyball Court. Late arrivals can check in at the store during extended hours.

events.title: Manager’s Welcome Mixer
events.description: Drop off the kids at the volleyball court for some prison ball and head to the Lair Lodge for the **Manager’s Welcome Mixer** with your Oski Manager, Jonathan, and your Program Director, Ellie. We’ll bring the kids over to dinner.

events.title: New Camper Tour
events.description: **New Camper Tour** Meet at the volleyball court for a tour of camp. All ages welcome.

events.title: Welcome Campfire!
events.description: **Welcome Campfire!** Meet your 2026 Camp Oski Staff at the Stage for some laughs and information about your week at our introductory show.

events.title: Allergy and Dietary Needs Meeting
events.description: **Allergy and Dietary Needs Meeting.** Meet with our Kitchen team in the Dining Hall to discuss any special dietary needs.

events.title: Creekside
events.description: **Creekside.** Come join the Music Director, Izzy, for relaxing music and inspirational readings. Stroll to a quiet grove just below D Circle by the creek. It's a great way to start the week. Camper participation is encouraged.

events.title: Wacky Sunday Pool Show!
events.description: **Wacky Sunday Pool Show!** Bring the whole family to the pool for some silliness, pool games, and root beer floats.

events.title: Inner Tube Water Polo
events.description: **Inner Tube Water Polo** - Campers vs. Staffers at the pool. C'mon campers, show off your athleticism. 18 and over please.

events.title: Guest Speaker: Rebecca Johnson
events.description: **Guest Speaker.** In her talk, _How People's Photos of Nature are Changing the Way We Do Science and Conservation in California and Beyond_, **Rebecca Johnson**, Director of the Center for Biodiversity and Community Science at the California Academy of Sciences and a Cal alumna whose academic journey began with the Moorea Field Course, explores how everyday people are transforming science. Through photos and observations shared by the public, researchers are gaining powerful new insights into California’s biodiversity and helping shape conservation efforts around the world. At the Stage. near the Gaga Pit by the bridge at 8pm to walk to the Gold Stage by 8:15.

events.title: Sonora Taqueria Pop Up at the Vista Lounge
events.description: **Sonora Taqueria Pop Up at the Vista Lounge.** Join us for an adults-only street taco night at the Vista Lodge! Complete with beer, wine, and margaritas. Sign up and pay in advance at the store. Spots are limited.

events.title: Family Disco Bingo in the Dining Hall
events.description: **Family Disco Bingo in the Dining Hall.** Wear disco clothes or any silly clothes, and bring 50 cents for a card. Oh, and be prepared to boogie down!!

events.title: Preparing for College
events.description: **Preparing for College:** For teens and parents of teens, come to the Teen Lodge and hear personal experiences from our veteran staffers and learn how they got into college. The Teen Lodge is located between Camps Gold and Blue.

events.title: Walk Together to Lunch at the Lake!
events.description: **Walk Together to Lunch at the Lake!** Meet at the Gaga Pit to walk over to Lunch at the Lake.

events.title: Vista Lounge!
events.description: **Vista Lounge!** Join us for a gourmet prime rib dinner with all the trimmings at Vista Lodge. Arrive at 6:00 PM for wine and appetizers; dinner is served at 6:30 PM. Sign up and pay in advance at the store. Seating is limited.

events.title: Guest Speaker: David Seaborg
events.description: **Guest Speaker.** In his talk, _How Organisms Create More Species by Improving Their Environment_, evolutionary biologist and World Rainforest Fund president **David Seaborg** presents his theory that life itself transformed Earth into a planet capable of supporting extraordinary biodiversity. With a special emphasis on rainforests, he’ll explore how organisms improve their environment, foster the evolution of new species through symbiosis and ecological balance, and why preserving these remarkable ecosystems is essential for the future of life on Earth. Meet near the Gaga Pit by the bridge at 8pm to walk to the Gold Stage by 8:15.

events.title: Family Sing-along!
events.description: **Family Sing-along!** B.Y.O. voice and instrument to the Stage for a fun evening.

events.title: Vista Lounge Dinner!
events.description: **Vista Lounge Dinner!** Join us for an adults-only, gourmet prime rib dinner with all the trimmings at Vista Lodge. Arrive at 6:00 PM for wine and appetizers; dinner is served at 6:30 PM. Sign up and pay in advance at the store. Seating is limited.

events.title: Oski Revue and Hootenany!
events.description: **Oski Revue and Hootenany!** Join the Music Director, Izzy, at the Stage for our camper talent show and staff Hootenany! Yeehaww!

events.title: ADULT DANCE
events.description: **ADULT DANCE** at Vista Lodge! Mix, mingle and boogie with your fellow campers from Blue, Gold, and Oski. Beer and wine provided -- 21+ only.

The meeting spot is located at the far-right entrance to the lake, near the fishing dock. See you there!
